killedFinal: 30 of 32 killed; survivors ['REV-2 review skips the span-text re-screen', 'SR-8 literal matches non-overlapping'], both argued equivalent below

equivalent.reason: the policy's one literal-fragment detector (private-key-material) is a wholeArtifactDetector, so any literal match excludes the body whole whichever matches are found; its values contain no line terminator, so a skipped overlapping match lies on a line an earlier match already touches. No body distinguishes the mutant under the approved bytes. [Inferred]

redactBody already excludes a body whole when any detector, from every offset, matches its retained text; a span is a substring of that text, and screenBody's first-match detectors find nothing the every-offset matcher misses, so the span re-screen is defence in depth that no input reaches. [Inferred]
